title: Compare Strings by Frequency of the Smallest Character
summary: Define the function f(s) as the frequency of the lexicographically smallest character in a non-empty string s .
statement: Define the function f(s) as the frequency of the lexicographically smallest character in a non-empty string s . Given an array of strings words and another array of strings queries, for each query in queries, count the number of words in words where the value of f for the query is less than the value of f for each word in words. Return an array of answers, where each answer corresponds to the result of each query.
constraints: For each query count words with strictly greater smallest-character frequency.
target_time_complexity: O(total characters + words log words + queries log words)
hints: Compute each string’s smallest character and count its occurrences.
For a query, binary-search the first word frequency strictly greater than its frequency.
Every suffix value after bisect_right is strictly larger, so its length is the requested count.
editorial: Every suffix value after bisect_right is strictly larger, so its length is the requested count.

tests.explanation: The smallest character occurs once in cbd and three times in zaaaz.
Frequencies three and two produce answer one and two respectively.
